work.author: Joseph Henry Thayer, translating, revising and enlarging Carl Ludwig Wilibald Grimm
work.description: Thayer's English recasting of Grimm's revision of Wilke's Clavis Novi Testamenti, the standard nineteenth-century English lexicon of New Testament Greek. It is an identified working authority, superseded for most purposes by twentieth-century lexicography. Loci are headwords.
work.title: A Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament, being Grimm's Wilke's Clavis Novi Testamenti
